subject: planner: fix wrongly skip plan cache with predicate simplification (#61515)
summary: Adds a small varargs helper in `pkg/expression` and updates predicate-simplification rules to only call `StmtCtx.SetSkipPlanCache(...)` when the simplification involves mutable constants (param markers/deferred expr) as detected by `MaybeOverOptimized4PlanCache`, avoiding unnecessary plan-cache skips for simplifications that are stable across executions.
